name: The Alliance Needs Singed Corestones!
statusNote: New in Forever. Its level is not known yet. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: champion, I need your help. In the Molten Core there are these stones, singed Corestones to be precise, that we need to harvest for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm told that our blacksmiths and engineers can put them to good use, so that's where you come in. I need you to go into the Molten Core and gather up as many of these corestones as you can. Of course, you'll want to talk thirty-nine of your closest friends along with you.
narrative.objectives: Bring 50 singed corestones to Commander Stronghammer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
